---

**How this works:**
1. Create this issue with the appropriate label (backend/frontend/firmware/library)
2. Centro de Control routes it to the specialized agent
3. The agent analyzes, implements, tests, and opens a PR
4. All CI/CD checks run automatically
5. PR auto-merges when all checks pass
6. Issue closes automatically with release information

**Questions?** Comment on this issue and the agent will respond.
